uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-1.name: Uluru
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-1.bio: Sandstone monolith sacred to Anangu, with a 9.8 km base walk and sunrise and sunset viewing areas.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-1.hours: Park hours by month: 5:00 AM – 9:00 PM (Dec–Feb) to 6:30 AM – 7:30 PM (Jun–Jul)
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-1.coordinates_source: OSM natural=peak 'Uluṟu' (Nominatim/Photon); Wikipedia Uluru (-25.345,131.036) 330 m away is a rounded reference. MEDIUM.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-1.notes: Cost is the 3-day adult park pass ($38, free under 18, sold at the entry station or online); the place itself has no separate charge. Climb permanently closed, not mentioned.

uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-2.name: Kata Tjuta
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-2.bio: Group of 36 domed rock formations west of Uluru, sacred to Anangu, with walks through its gorges.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-2.hours: Park hours by month: 5:00 AM – 9:00 PM (Dec–Feb) to 6:30 AM – 7:30 PM (Jun–Jul); leave 45 min before closing
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-2.notes: Cost is the 3-day adult park pass ($38, free under 18, sold at the entry station or online); the place itself has no separate charge.

uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-3.name: Uluru Base Walk
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-3.bio: Flat 9.8 km track around the base of Uluru, taking three to four hours, with sacred sites marked by signs.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-3.hours: Park hours by month: 5:00 AM – 9:00 PM (Dec–Feb) to 6:30 AM – 7:30 PM (Jun–Jul)
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-3.coordinates_source: OSM node on the route ('Northern Uluru Base Walk' marker, emergency=phone). Only a marker, not the route midpoint: the full loop is not available as a way (Overpass down). MEDIUM, flagged for review.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-3.notes: Cost is the 3-day adult park pass ($38, free under 18, sold at the entry station or online); the place itself has no separate charge. Loop: the marker is on the north-east side of the loop.

uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-4.name: Valley of the Winds Walk
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-4.bio: Grade 4 circuit of about 7.4 km among the Kata Tjuta domes to two lookouts, taking three to four hours.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-4.hours: Park hours; closes at Karu Lookout from 11 AM when 36°C or more is forecast
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-4.coordinates_source: Midpoint of OSM way 27444533 'Valley of the Winds Walk' (2.4 km mapped of the walk). MEDIUM.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-4.notes: Cost is the 3-day adult park pass ($38, free under 18, sold at the entry station or online); the place itself has no separate charge. Draft said 2.5-3.5 h; Parks Australia gives 3-4 h.

uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-5.name: Uluru-Kata Tjuta Cultural Centre
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-5.bio: Visitor and cultural centre near the base of Uluru, with Anangu art, galleries, exhibitions and a café.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-5.coordinates_source: OSM information=office 'Uluṟu-Kata Tjuṯa Cultural Centre' (Photon); a tourism=information node 'Visitor's Center' is 47 m away. MEDIUM.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-5.notes: Cost is the 3-day adult park pass ($38, free under 18, sold at the entry station or online); the place itself has no separate charge. Centre entry is free once inside the park.

uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-6.name: Field of Light
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-6.bio: Bruce Munro's light installation of illuminated stems near Yulara, seen at sunrise or after dark.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-6.hours: Sunrise and after-dark sessions (times vary by season)
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-6.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=artwork 'Field of Light' (Photon) + Commons geotag median 0.1 m... within 20 m. HIGH.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-6.notes: Adult general admission about $50 (operator page snippet, April 2025-Mar 2026 band; 2026-27 price not confirmed). Outside the park gate: no park pass needed. Star Pass and dinner packages cost more.

uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-7.name: Talinguru Nyakunytjaku
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-7.bio: Sunrise viewing area for Uluru and Kata Tjuta, with platforms and a 1.4 km circuit of two short walks.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-7.hours: Park hours by month: 5:00 AM – 9:00 PM (Dec–Feb) to 6:30 AM – 7:30 PM (Jun–Jul)
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-7.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=viewpoint 'Talinguru Nyakunytjaku Sunrise Viewpoint' (Photon). MEDIUM.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-7.notes: Cost is the 3-day adult park pass ($38, free under 18, sold at the entry station or online); the place itself has no separate charge.

uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-8.name: Mala Walk
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-8.bio: Easy 2 km return walk from the Mala car park along Uluru's base to Kantju Gorge, with a daily ranger walk.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-8.hours: Park hours by month: 5:00 AM – 9:00 PM (Dec–Feb) to 6:30 AM – 7:30 PM (Jun–Jul); ranger walk 8 AM (Oct–Apr), 10 AM (May–Sep)
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-8.coordinates_source: Midpoint of OSM way 227348304 'Mala Walk' (159 m mapped). MEDIUM.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-8.notes: Cost is the 3-day adult park pass ($38, free under 18, sold at the entry station or online); the place itself has no separate charge. Ranger-guided Mala walk is free with the pass.

uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-9.name: Kuniya Walk
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-9.bio: One-kilometre return walk to Mutitjulu Waterhole on Uluru's south side, with rock art and a creation story.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-9.hours: Park hours by month: 5:00 AM – 9:00 PM (Dec–Feb) to 6:30 AM – 7:30 PM (Jun–Jul)
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-9.coordinates_source: Midpoint of OSM way 25872901 'Kuniya Walk' (120 m mapped). MEDIUM.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-9.notes: Cost is the 3-day adult park pass ($38, free under 18, sold at the entry station or online); the place itself has no separate charge.

uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-10.name: Walpa Gorge Walk
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-10.bio: Easy 2.6 km return walk into a gorge between two Kata Tjuta domes, with steep rock walls either side.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-10.hours: Park hours by month: 5:00 AM – 9:00 PM (Dec–Feb) to 6:30 AM – 7:30 PM (Jun–Jul)
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-10.coordinates_source: Midpoint of OSM way 17610762 'Walpa Gorge Walk' (289 m mapped). MEDIUM.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-10.notes: Cost is the 3-day adult park pass ($38, free under 18, sold at the entry station or online); the place itself has no separate charge.

uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-11.name: Yulara
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-11.bio: Resort village just outside the park, the base for accommodation, dining, tours and flights to Uluru.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-11.notes: Outside the park gate, so no pass. Imalung Lookout is 57 m away (>25 m).

uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-12.name: Imalung Lookout
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-12.bio: Sand-dune lookout on the Yulara drive loop with views of Uluru and part of Kata Tjuta.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-12.notes: Inside Yulara, outside the park gate: free. 57 m from the Yulara town point.

uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-13.name: Kata Tjuta Dune Viewing Area
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-13.bio: Short walk up a sand dune beside the Kata Tjuta road, with views of the domes and Uluru in the distance.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-13.hours: Park hours by month: 5:00 AM – 9:00 PM (Dec–Feb) to 6:30 AM – 7:30 PM (Jun–Jul)
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-13.coordinates_source: OSM highway=footway 'Kata Tjuta Dune Walk' (Photon); the 'Dune Viewing Area' marker is 9 m away. MEDIUM.
uluru-kata-tjuta-national-park-13.notes: Cost is the 3-day adult park pass ($38, free under 18, sold at the entry station or online); the place itself has no separate charge.

hermannsburg.name: Hermannsburg (Ntaria)
hermannsburg.bio: Aboriginal community on Larapinta Drive, a former Lutheran mission and the home of painter Albert Namatjira.
hermannsburg.hours: Historic Precinct 9:00 AM – 4:30 PM when open; closed for the 2026 season
hermannsburg.notes: PRECINCT CLOSED for the 2026 season per its own site (fetched Oct 2026). Adult entry $18.50 from an older snippet of the same site; not re-verified. Recommend holding until it reopens.

finke-gorge-national-park.name: Finke Gorge National Park
finke-gorge-national-park.bio: Remote national park around the Finke River and Palm Valley, reached by high-clearance 4WD along the river bed.
finke-gorge-national-park.hours: Open 24 hours; road may close after rain
finke-gorge-national-park.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=camp_site 'Palm Valley Campground' (park visitor point; not Palm Valley's own pin, 3.4 km away). MEDIUM.
finke-gorge-national-park.notes: Cost is the NT Parks Visitor Pass, $10 adult per day ($20 for three days; NT residents exempt; by-laws March 2026, via search snippet); camping is extra.

palm-valley.name: Palm Valley
palm-valley.bio: Oasis of rare red cabbage palms and cycads, with short walks and a lookout over Palm Creek.
palm-valley.hours: Open 24 hours; road may close after rain
palm-valley.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=attraction 'Palm Valley' (Nominatim node, at Arankaia Walk). MEDIUM.
palm-valley.notes: Cost is the NT Parks Visitor Pass, $10 adult per day ($20 for three days; NT residents exempt; by-laws March 2026, via search snippet); camping is extra. Near-duplicate risk with the park: kept as the valley, the park as its access/camping point.

gosses-bluff.name: Gosses Bluff (Tnorala)
gosses-bluff.bio: Ring of hills left by a meteorite impact, sacred ground on the Mereenie Loop road, reached by 4WD.
gosses-bluff.coordinates_source: OSM natural=peak 'Gosses Bluff North' (crater rim). The reserve visitor/lookout point was not found: pin LOW.
gosses-bluff.notes: pin LOW: rim summit, not a standing point. Mereenie Loop pass needed to drive the road (about $5, older snippets; Central Land Council). Parks Pass applicability to Tnorala unverified.

chambers-pillar.name: Chambers Pillar
chambers-pillar.bio: A 50 m sandstone column rising from the desert plain, reached by a 4WD track south of Alice Springs, best at sunset.
chambers-pillar.hours: Open 24 hours; road may close after rain
chambers-pillar.coordinates_source: OSM tourism=viewpoint 'Chambers Pillar' (+natural=cliff same feature, 11 m). MEDIUM.
chambers-pillar.notes: Cost is the NT Parks Visitor Pass, $10 adult per day ($20 for three days; NT residents exempt; by-laws March 2026, via search snippet); camping is extra.

rainbow-valley.name: Rainbow Valley
rainbow-valley.bio: Reserve of striped sandstone bluffs and cliffs south of Alice Springs, with short walks to the claypan.
rainbow-valley.notes: Cost is the NT Parks Visitor Pass, $10 adult per day ($20 for three days; NT residents exempt; by-laws March 2026, via search snippet); camping is extra. ticketUrl is the agency fact sheet PDF; unloaded.

ewaninga-conservation-reserve.name: Ewaninga Rock Carvings
ewaninga-conservation-reserve.bio: Small reserve of ancient rock engravings on a sandstone outcrop, south of Alice Springs on the Old South Road.
ewaninga-conservation-reserve.wiki: Napwerte / Ewaninga Rock Carvings Conservation Reserve
ewaninga-conservation-reserve.coordinates_source: OSM leisure=nature_reserve centroid (small reserve) + Wikipedia ~1 km off; pin LOW, carvings' standing point not found.
ewaninga-conservation-reserve.notes: pin LOW: reserve centroid. Cost is the NT Parks Visitor Pass, $10 adult per day ($20 for three days; NT residents exempt; by-laws March 2026, via search snippet); camping is extra. No specific agency page found (only the Find a park list).

henbury-meteorites-conservation-reserve.name: Henbury Meteorites
henbury-meteorites-conservation-reserve.bio: Twelve small craters formed by a meteorite impact about 4,700 years ago, with short walks around them.
henbury-meteorites-conservation-reserve.coordinates_source: OSM leisure=nature_reserve centroid agrees with Wikipedia (-24.5725,133.1478) within 150 m; pin LOW-MEDIUM, reserve centroid not the car park.
henbury-meteorites-conservation-reserve.notes: Name shortened from the article title (in wiki). Cost is the NT Parks Visitor Pass, $10 adult per day ($20 for three days; NT residents exempt; by-laws March 2026, via search snippet); camping is extra.

curtin-springs.name: Curtin Springs
curtin-springs.bio: Family-run cattle station and roadside inn on the Lasseter Highway with camping, a store and meals, on the way to Uluru.
curtin-springs.coordinates_source: Commons geotag median (15 files) and OSM place=hamlet node (-25.3143,131.7569) agree within 80 m. HIGH.
curtin-springs.notes: Hours: store from 7 AM; meals 7-2 and 5-6:30 (older post). Stopping is free; meals/camping extra.

destination.name: Uluru-Kata Tjuta National Park
destination.tagline: Uluru and the domes of Kata Tjuta, on Anangu country in the Red Centre.
destination.description: Uluru-Kata Tjuta National Park, in the Red Centre of the Northern Territory, is a World Heritage area managed jointly with its Anangu Traditional Owners. Uluru is a sandstone monolith ringed by a 9.8 km base walk, and Kata Tjuta is a group of 36 domes to the west with walks into its gorges. The Cultural Centre explains Anangu law and art. Most visitors stay at Yulara, the resort village just outside the park.
whyVisit: Watch Uluru glow at sunrise and sunset
Hike among the Kata Tjuta domes
Circle Uluru on the Base Walk
Learn Anangu culture at the Cultural Centre

goodToKnow.title: Park pass required
goodToKnow.detail: Adults need a park pass: $38 for three days, free under 18. Buy it online or at the entry station on arrival.

goodToKnow.title: Walk early in the heat
goodToKnow.detail: Valley of the Winds closes at Karu Lookout from 11 am when 36°C or more is forecast. Start at dawn and carry water.

goodToKnow.title: Opening hours change
goodToKnow.detail: The park shuts overnight: 5 am to 9 pm in summer, 6:30 am to 7:30 pm in June and July. Leave Kata Tjuta 45 minutes before closing.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: The cooler months, {months}, suit the walks; in summer the heat can close Valley of the Winds by 11 am.

destinations.notes: Pin: park entry station, from two agreeing Commons geotagged photos 'Uluru-Kata Tjuta National Park entry station' (-25.27538,130.97639) and 'Entrance to the Uluru Kata Tjuta National Park' (~70 m away); not OSM-mapped. >25 m from every spot. All 13 spots within span (farthest Kata Tjuta about 24 km from the pin; span 60 km, 75% = 45 km). Order kept as placement. Pass decision: $38 3-day adult pass costed on every in-gate spot (Uluru, Kata Tjuta, walks, Cultural Centre, Talinguru, dune area) since each needs it; Yulara, Imalung and Field of Light are outside the gate (Field of Light carries its own ticket). Climb is closed and not mentioned.
